title: The scaffold protein AXIN1: gene ontology, signal network, and physiological function.
authors: Qiu, Lu; Sun, Yixuan; Ning, Haoming; Chen, Guanyu; Zhao, Wenshan; Gao, Yanfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文综述支架蛋白AXIN1在WNT等信号通路中的功能，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AXIN1, has been initially identified as a prominent antagonist within the WNT/beta-catenin signaling pathway, and subsequently unveiled its integral involvement across a diverse spectrum of signaling cascades. These encompass the WNT/beta-catenin, Hippo, TGFbeta, AMPK, mTOR, MAPK, and antioxidant signaling pathways. The versatile engagement of AXIN1 underscores its pivotal role in the modulation of developmental biological signaling, maintenance of metabolic homeostasis, and coordination of cellular stress responses. The multifaceted functionalities of AXIN1 render it as a compelling candidate for targeted intervention in the realms of degenerative pathologies, systemic metabolic disorders, cancer therapeutics, and anti-aging strategies. This review provides an intricate exploration of the mechanisms governing mammalian AXIN1 gene expression and protein turnover since its initial discovery, while also elucidating its significance in the regulation of signaling pathways, tissue development, and carcinogenesis. Furthermore, we have introduced the innovative concept of the AXIN1-Associated Phosphokinase Complex (AAPC), where the scaffold protein AXIN1 assumes a pivotal role in orchestrating site-specific phosphorylation modifications through interactions with various phosphokinases and their respective substrates.
abstract_zh: AXIN1，最初被鉴定为WNT/β-catenin信号通路中的主要拮抗剂，随后揭示了其在多种信号级联反应中的不可或缺参与。这些包括WNT/β-catenin、Hippo、TGFbeta、AMPK、mTOR、MAPK及抗氧化信号通路。AXIN1的多功能参与凸显了其在调节发育生物学信号、维持代谢稳态以及协调细胞应激反应中的关键作用。AXIN1的多方面功能使其成为退行性疾病、系统性代谢紊乱、癌症治疗及抗衰老策略中靶向干预的有力候选者。本综述自AXIN1首次发现以来，深入探讨了哺乳动物AXIN1基因表达和蛋白质周转的机制，同时阐明了其在信号通路调控、组织发育及癌变中的重要性。此外，我们引入了AXIN1相关磷酸激酶复合物（AAPC）的创新概念，其中支架蛋白AXIN1通过与多种磷酸激酶及其相应底物的相互作用，在协调位点特异性磷酸化修饰中发挥关键作用。
